Green Collar Agritech Solutions Founding Year : 2022 Location : Bangalore, India Use For : Crop Growth Analytics
PAGE_BLOCKS.b3: Indian startup Green Collar Agritech Solutions creates crop growth analytics utilizing machine learning and AI to increase agricultural production. It provides real-time insights about crop health and growth patterns by analyzing large datasets from multiple sources, such as sensor data and satellite photography. The startup’s TARAM is a portable AI-powered device for instant, on-site quality analysis of spices and high-value crops. The TARAM-IQ platform aggregates and analyzes data on quality, quantity, and location to support better decision-making in the agricultural value chain. This way, Green Collar Agritech Solutions provides farmers with useful information that raises the caliber of agricultural products, encourages sustainable farming methods, and boosts food security. 2. Abit Founding Year : 2022 Location : Milan, Italy Use For : Functional Biodiversity Management Software Italian startup Abit offers biodiversity management tools for farmers to preserve the ecological balance of agricultural systems. The startup’s platform utilizes AI to analyze biodiversity data and forecast how different agricultural methods affect the health of ecosystems. It provides information on crop diversity, pest management, and soil health by combining real-time analytics with biodiversity measures. This enables farmers to implement more environmentally friendly methods. The main advantages of this platform include improved decision-making skills, increased crop resistance to pests and diseases, and resource efficiency. 3. Yevul Info Founding Year : 2022 Location : Katzrin, Israel Use For : AI-enhanced Plant Health Detection
PAGE_BLOCKS.b4: Israeli startup Yevul Info ‘s AI-enhanced plant health detection system spots minute variations in the green of plant leaves before visible deterioration. It analyzes subtle changes in leaf color and texture using imagery and machine learning algorithms to provide early indications of possible health problems. This tech enables farmers to prevent crop loss by taking proactive steps, such as modifying watering techniques or nutrient levels, based on early signals. Yevul Info provides farmers with timely insights to improve crop management and yields for promoting food security and sustainable agriculture. 4. Addium Founding Year : 2022 Location : Pullman, WA, USA Use For : Food Safety and Quality Control US-based startup Addium provides solutions for food safety and quality management that improve agricultural practices. The startup’s technology ensures optimal growing conditions for crops using real-time data collection and analysis. It monitors variables like soil moisture, temperature, and climatic conditions. Its product AROYA is a comprehensive hardware and software platform that integrates patented sensors, automation, and analytics. It optimizes crop steering, irrigation, environmental control, and compliance for growers to maximize yield and consistency. Further, the AQUALAB solution enables water activity and moisture analysis for enabling precise control of moisture to improve product quality, shelf life, and process efficiency. 5. BioArmix Founding Year : 2023 Location : Katzrin, Israel Use For : Pathogenic Bacteria Protection
PAGE_BLOCKS.b5: Israeli startup BioArmix provides pathogenic bacteria protection solutions utilising naturally occurring predatory bacteria. The company’s method allows for on-demand activation and long-term ambient storage by encapsulating non-GMO predatory bacteria as dry powder. These bacteria target and consume gram-negative pathogens, like those that cause soft rot in potatoes. They enter the pathogens’ cell walls, proliferate inside, and destroy them without endangering helpful microorganisms. The solution offers a resistance-free mechanism, microbiome-friendly methodology, and adaptable application techniques – like soil carriers, seed coatings, and irrigation systems. LAKTOWASH enhances milk quality and convertibility for fermented dairy products by reducing bacterial load and somatic cell counts in milk. 7. The platform enhances food security and climate resilience by offering customised suggestions for specific farm conditions. 8. Companies in this space provide tools for crop monitoring, soil analysis, smart irrigation, disease detection, precision spraying, farm management, yield analysis, and AI automation.
